_comment: Hand-written raw-spec.json, used by checks.resolve-lazy-self's step 5b (#49). lazy.nvim as a
*local* (dev/dir) plugin that also happens to set `pin = true`. This unnatural combination is
the only guard for the `dev`/`dir` exclusion from `lazy_is_spec`: without it, `lazy_pinned`
would wrongly become true for a local lazy.nvim, and a bare `--update` would drop the
synthetic `lazy-nvim` seed input from the update-plan -- breaking #24's "a no-names update
always includes the seed input" contract, silently, with no other check able to catch it
(resolve.lua's own bare `--update` force-set loop already excludes dev/dir plugins on the *force*
side, so only the update-plan writer's exclusion can regress here).
`dir` is a nonexistent path on purpose: this fixture never builds anything, only exercises
